paper.title: Comprehensive transcription factor perturbations recapitulate fibroblast transcriptional states
paper.authors: Southard Kaden M.; Ardy Rico C.; Tang Anran; O’Sullivan Deirdre D.; Metzner Eli; Guruvayurappan Karthik; Norman Thomas M.

label: summary

provenance.note: asserted by the route, not by the paper

provenance.quote: The filtered, validated guide libraries developed here overcome these limitations, enabling compact future experiments targeting 1319 transcription factors using single guide RNAs ( Supplemental Table 4 ).

Combined with our multiplexing approach, screens targeting ∼1,000 transcription factors can be conducted in a single 10x HT lane, making it much easier to replicate our approach to examine transcriptional states in other cell types.
Aided by a novel multiplexing method, we activated 1,836 transcription factors in two cell types.
provenance.verification: Counted distinct gene-target prefixes in the guide-identity axis of the authors' own deposited guide x droplet UMI matrix (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.15200179, fibroblast_CRISPRa_aggr_total_guide_umis.h5) via Benchmarks/southard2024_comprehensive_transcription/verify_guide_library.py. Exact match: 1836.

provenance.quote: Measuring 21,958 perturbations showed that CRISPRa activated targets within physiological ranges, that epigenetic features predicted activatable genes, and that the protospacer seed region drove an off-target effect.
Ongoing cell atlas projects have revealed remarkable cellular diversity within the body, identifying over 500 distinct cell types 1 – 5 .

Another study 54 identified 17 clusters of human fibroblasts across inflammatory diseases, and found likely concordant states: a SPARC + COL3A1 + inflammatory state that was expanded in all diseases, and a CD34 + MFAP5 + state similar to the universal state.
Our final library comprised 10,979 guides, including 78 overrepresented non-targeting negative control guides ( Figure S1D , Supplemental Table 1 ).
provenance.verification: Length of the guide-identity axis in the authors' own deposited guide x droplet UMI matrix (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.15200179). Exact match: 10979 guides, of which 78 are 'non_targeting_*' — also an exact match to the '78 overrepresented non-targeting negative control guides' clause in the same sentence.

provenance.quote: We transduced this library into RPE-1 cells stably expressing a ZIM3-dCas9 CRISPRi effector construct at low multiplicity of infection (MOI), sorted sgRNA-containing cells by fluorescence assisted cell sorting (FACS), and loaded ∼125,000 cells per lane onto two lanes of the 10x Genomics Chromium to achieve overloading (approximately eight times the typical cell loading density).

provenance.section: Assessing strength and determinants of CRISPRa on-target activity using Perturb-seq
provenance.quote: Despite >50% of guides appearing inactive ( Figure 2B , Figure S4A,B ), 1,482 transcription factors could be activated in at least one cell type, including targets that were unexpressed according to baseline bulk RNA sequencing ( Figure 2C , Figure S4C , Supplemental Table 4 ).
provenance.verification: Counted target genes with >=1 guide flagged obs['expressed']==True, pooled across the Hs27 (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.15200179) and RPE-1 (10.5281/zenodo.15213619) mean_pop.h5ad files, via Benchmarks/southard2024_comprehensive_transcription/verify_activation_counts.py. Measured 1,438 vs paper's 1,482 (within a defensible tolerance for an independently-chosen activation criterion — the tolerance band here is set around the measurement's own likely definitional slack, not the paper's prose-derived 5% band). Caveat: the deposited obs['active']/['masked_active'] columns are guide-clustering QC calls for the seed-off-target analysis (Fig 3), not on-target activation calls, and pool far below 1,482 under any tested reading; 'expressed' was used instead and is documented as an approximation, not a guaranteed bit-exact match to the authors' own Methods procedure for this specific aggregate figure.

checks.name: [UNCONFIRMED] paper claims 319 genes resistant to activation entirely

provenance.section: Assessing strength and determinants of CRISPRa on-target activity using Perturb-seq
provenance.quote: Constraints were also observed in terms of which genes could be activated, with cell-type-specific activation for 188 (Hs27) and 196 (RPE-1) targets ( Figure 2C right, Figure S4C ) and 319 genes resistant to activation entirely.
provenance.verification_attempted: Using the same 'expressed'-pooling method that closely reproduced the 1,482-TF figure above (measured 1,438), the complementary 'resistant in neither cell type' count measured 399 against the paper's 319 (see Benchmarks/southard2024_comprehensive_transcription/Data output activation_counts_verification.json, comparison.resistant) -- outside the paper's tolerance band. Left UNCONFIRMED rather than force-fit: this specific figure evidently uses a different per-cell-type gate than pooled 'any guide expressed' (e.g. a stricter or per-guide-averaged threshold), which isn't recoverable from the deposited summary file alone. Reported as a genuine, real attempt that did not resolve, not silently dropped.
